description: Find all lists containing a specific company or person record. Never modify list memberships or retrieve list entries. Requires recordId; processes 5 lists in parallel by default (max 20). If record not found, verify recordId with search_records first.

batchSize.description: Number of lists to process in parallel (1-20, default: 5)

includeEntryValues.description: Whether to include entry values in the response (e.g., stage, status)

recordId.description: ID of the record to find in lists

name: get-record-list-memberships
